title: UI misrepresentation in Chrome Payments
summary: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in the Payments component of Chrome before 154.0.8037.57 could allow a remote attacker to spoof payment UI via a crafted HTML page. Rated Medium by Google.

title: Missing authorization in Chrome for Android
summary: A missing authorization issue in Chrome for Android before 153.0.8010.47 could allow a local attacker with a co-installed app to obtain sensitive information.

title: Permission restriction issue in Safari and Apple platforms
summary: A permissions issue affecting Safari and multiple Apple platforms was addressed with additional restrictions.

title: DOM and HTML spoofing issue in Firefox
summary: A spoofing issue in the DOM Core and HTML component was fixed in Firefox 152 and Thunderbird 152.

title: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Microsoft Edge
summary: A user-interface misrepresentation issue could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

title: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Edge for Android
summary: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in Edge for Android could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing.

title: UI misrepresentation and network spoofing in Edge for Android
summary: A user-interface misrepresentation issue in Edge for Android could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform spoofing.
